sentences.en: Welcome everyone to the Sunday special.

sentences.en: I'm Gilbert Cruz.

sentences.en: I'm excited because today we're talking about one of my secret favorite things.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋，因为今天我们要聊聊我私下最喜欢的东西之一。

sentences.en: It's not movies or books or TV, all of which honestly are some of my favorite things in the world.

sentences.en: Instead, we are talking about amusement parks.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊的是游乐园。

sentences.en: All year round, Americans travel to Orlando and Los Angeles and Anaheim to go to some of the most famous theme parks around.
sentences.zh: 一年四季，美国人都会前往奥兰多、洛杉矶和阿纳海姆，去逛逛那些最著名的主题公园。

sentences.en: And those who don't go there are likely going somewhere close to home, like the Six Flags that I used to go to in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 而那些不去这些地方的人，很可能会去离家近的地方，比如我以前在新泽西常去的六旗乐园。

sentences.zh: 这也是环球影业大力推销《魔法坏女巫》的原因之一，对吧？

sentences.en: Wicked, Wicked, Wicked, was to make the movie a success, but also, you know, they haven't announced anything, but you can bet there will be a Wicked land.
sentences.zh: 《魔法坏女巫》、《魔法坏女巫》、《魔法坏女巫》，不仅是为了让电影成功，而且，你知道，虽然他们还没宣布任何消息，但你可以肯定未来会有“魔法坏女巫”主题园区。

sentences.en: Yeah, it'll be an Emerald City corner of one of their parks.
sentences.zh: 没错，那会是他们某个乐园里翡翠城的一角。

sentences.en: Just to be clear, I am offended that Twilight Zone is no longer intellectual property that means anything to the kids.
sentences.zh: 声明一下，我对《阴阳魔界》不再是孩子们在意的知识产权感到很冒犯。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: For all the kids listening, you need to watch some New Year's Eve Twilight Zone marathons.
sentences.zh: 所有正在收听的孩子们，你们需要去看一些新年前夜的《阴阳魔界》马拉松节目。

sentences.en: I now go to the parks primarily for my job, right?
sentences.zh: 我现在去乐园主要是为了工作，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm usually reporting when I'm in them.
sentences.zh: 我在里面的时候通常是在做报道。

sentences.en: But I'm definitely, as a fan, I'm definitely someone who wants to go to have the nostalgia button pushed, whether it's a ride I rode as a kid, still being that same ride.
sentences.zh: 但作为粉丝，我绝对是一个想去重温怀旧感的人，无论是坐我小时候坐过的游乐设施，还是保持着同样体验的设施。

sentences.en: You know, the Tiki Room at Disneyland is popular with no one except me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，迪士尼乐园的提基神殿除了我之外没人喜欢。

sentences.en: It's popular, hey, Tiki, Tiki, Tiki, Tiki, Tiki Room.
sentences.zh: 它很受欢迎，嘿，提基，提基，提基，提基，提基神殿。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: I got it in my head.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里一直回荡着这个。

sentences.en: They would love, I think, to use that space for something else.
sentences.zh: 我想他们很乐意把那个空间挪作他用。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it is sort of distressing as an older person when you see some of the classic stuff, you know, fading away.
sentences.zh: 但是，没错，作为一个上了年纪的人，看到一些经典的东西逐渐消失，确实让人感到有些难过。

sentences.en: I feel like I still have nostalgia for theme parks that I went to when I was younger, amusement parks.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我对年轻时去过的主题公园、游乐园仍然怀有怀旧之情。

sentences.en: But now the nostalgia is not for the experience.
sentences.zh: 但现在的怀旧不再是为了那种体验。

sentences.en: The nostalgia is for the movie that you watch.
sentences.zh: 现在的怀旧是为了你观看的电影。

sentences.en: The nostalgia is for the Finding Nemo submarine, not the 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea submarine.
sentences.zh: 怀旧的是《海底总动员》的潜水艇，而不是《海底两万里》的潜水艇。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Although, maybe in the past, I mean, there was 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea movie.
sentences.zh: 虽然，也许过去，我是说，确实有《海底两万里》这部电影。

sentences.en: So it could have been the same.
sentences.zh: 所以它本可以是同一个东西。

sentences.en: But it's heightened, is the point.
sentences.zh: 但重点是，这种感觉被强化了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Let's take a quick break.
sentences.zh: 我们先休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we come back, we're going to talk roller coasters.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们要聊聊过山车。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Mikado, we're going to get into it now.
sentences.zh: 那么，Mikado，我们现在要进入正题了。

sentences.en: Are you ready?
sentences.zh: 你准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: I know you are the roller coaster meister.
sentences.zh: 我知道你是过山车大师。

sentences.en: How many roller coasters have you been on?
sentences.zh: 你坐过多少次过山车？

sentences.en: Do you keep track in a book, a spreadsheet?
sentences.zh: 你有用书或电子表格记录吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a website called Coaster Count.
sentences.zh: 有的，有一个叫Coaster Count的网站。

sentences.en: Coaster Count.
sentences.zh: 过山车计数。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We are doing free ads, apparently.
sentences.zh: 看来我们是在做免费广告了。

sentences.en: And you can go on there and it has all the parks listed and all of the rides that have ever been in that park.
sentences.zh: 你可以在上面查看，它列出了所有的乐园以及该乐园里出现过的所有游乐设施。

sentences.en: I started using it long after I started riding things.
sentences.zh: 我是在开始玩很久之后才开始用它的。

sentences.en: That's why I can't remember if I rode certain things at certain parks.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我不记得在某些乐园是否坐过某些设施。

sentences.en: So, I don't have a completely accurate count at the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，目前我还没有一个完全准确的统计数字。

sentences.en: I would say, generally speaking, more than 200.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我想应该超过200次了。

sentences.en: More than 200.
sentences.zh: 超过200次。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That would put you probably in, like, the top 5% of people who have ridden roller coasters, I would imagine.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概让你进入了坐过过山车的人群中的前5%。

sentences.en: I would imagine so, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想是的，没错。

sentences.en: I feel like every year I hear about some trip or another that you took to go ride roller coasters.
sentences.zh: 我觉得每年都能听到你又去坐过山车的旅行。

sentences.en: I think, correct me if I'm wrong, this year you went to Europe?
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我没记错的话，今年你去欧洲了？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: You're right about that.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: What are the stats on that?
sentences.zh: 那次的统计数据如何？

sentences.en: We spent a week in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们在欧洲待了一周。

sentences.en: It was one week, seven parks, four countries, 100 rides.
sentences.zh: 那是一周时间，去了七个乐园，四个国家，坐了100次游乐设施。

sentences.en: That's a great movie poster tagline right there.
sentences.zh: 那真是一句很棒的电影海报标语。

sentences.en: I'm just going to do a lot of fanny pack holding on that trip.
sentences.zh: 在那次旅行中，我只是负责帮大家拿腰包。

sentences.en: I don't want my hair messed up.
sentences.zh: 我不想弄乱我的头发。

sentences.en: I don't want to get wet.
sentences.zh: 我不想弄湿。

sentences.en: I don't want to feel sick.
sentences.zh: 我不想感到恶心。

sentences.en: You know, I'm happy to sort of stand and watch.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我很高兴站在一旁观看。

sentences.en: They weren't all roller coasters, so there are things that you could have ridden as well, Brooks.
sentences.zh: 它们并不全是过山车，所以也有你可以坐的设施，Brooks。

sentences.en: We also do like a good log flume and a river rapids ride and what enthusiasts call a dark ride, which is basically an indoor ride,
sentences.zh: 我们也喜欢好的原木漂流、激流勇进，还有爱好者们所说的“黑暗骑乘”，基本上就是室内游乐设施，

sentences.en: like an indoor roller coaster or an indoor boat ride.
sentences.zh: 比如室内过山车或室内乘船游览。

sentences.en: So you have to tell me, it would be journalistic malpractice not to ask you in this chair, what are some of your favorite roller coasters?
sentences.zh: 所以你得告诉我，如果坐在这把椅子上不问你这个问题，那简直是新闻失职，你最喜欢的过山车有哪些？

sentences.en: Well, I'm happy to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很乐意聊聊这个。

sentences.en: So one of my absolute favorites, it's a ride at Magic Mountain that is now called Twisted Colossus.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的绝对是魔术山乐园里的一个设施，现在叫“扭曲巨像”。

sentences.en: So they took the old wooden Colossus ride and this company called Rocky Mountain Construction,
sentences.zh: 他们拆掉了旧的木质“巨像”过山车，然后一家叫Rocky Mountain Construction的公司，

sentences.en: one of the big things that they do is go and take old wooden coasters and retrofit them with these customized steel tracks that they make.
sentences.zh: 他们的一大业务就是去改造旧的木质过山车，用他们定制的钢轨进行翻新。

sentences.en: And so they did that with the old Colossus and created this new ride, Twisted Colossus.
sentences.zh: 他们对旧的“巨像”做了同样的处理，创造了这个新的设施——“扭曲巨像”。

sentences.en: And now it's this amazing racing coaster where— So it's sort of two cars, you can see each other?
sentences.zh: 现在它是一个很棒的竞速过山车，两辆车可以互相看到？

sentences.en: Two cars that can see each other.
sentences.zh: 两辆车可以互相看到。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: There's one element on it that's called a high five where the track, both tracks go sideways, right?
sentences.zh: 上面有一个元素叫“击掌”，两条轨道都侧向倾斜，对吧？

sentences.en: And so you go through that part of the track sideways.
sentences.zh: 所以你侧着身子穿过那段轨道。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, that— That sounds so great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以没错，那——听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: It blew my mind the first time I rode it.
sentences.zh: 我第一次坐的时候简直惊呆了。

sentences.en: And I just—even to this day, like, I'm super thrilled by that roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我对那个过山车依然感到超级兴奋。

sentences.en: And then another one that actually just became a very recent favorite is a ride that I just rode this year.
sentences.zh: 还有一个最近才成为我最爱之一的设施，是我今年刚坐过的。

sentences.en: Uh, it's at this park in Belgium called Plopsaland and—
sentences.zh: 它在比利时一个叫Plopsaland的乐园里，然后——

sentences.en: Plopsaland?
sentences.zh: Plopsaland？

sentences.en: Plopsaland.
sentences.zh: Plopsaland。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It sort of competes with Schlitterbahn in Texas for the most awkwardly named theme park.
sentences.zh: 它在主题公园名字尴尬程度上，大概能和德克萨斯州的Schlitterbahn竞争一下。

sentences.en: Um, Plopsaland is this really fun park in Belgium, and they did just put in this incredible roller coaster called The Ride to Happiness.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Plopsaland是比利时一个非常有趣的乐园，他们刚刚安装了一个令人难以置信的过山车，叫“幸福之旅”。

sentences.en: And— In case it's not subtle.
sentences.zh: 而且——以防它不够含蓄。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Hey, it's kind of one of the great roller coaster ride names, I think, actually.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我觉得这其实是过山车名字里最棒的一个。

sentences.en: But it is a spinning launch coaster.
sentences.zh: 但它是一个旋转弹射过山车。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, the seats on the ride actually rotate, and then the ride also launches you into these hills and into loops and everything.
sentences.zh: 所以，座位会旋转，然后设施还会把你弹射出去，进入各种坡道、环形轨道等等。

sentences.en: But one of the cool things is, right out of the gate, the train does an immediate inversion.
sentences.zh: 但最酷的事情之一是，刚出发时，列车会立即进行一次翻转。

sentences.en: They have a corkscrew or, like, a twist right at the beginning of the ride.
sentences.zh: 他们在设施刚开始就有一个螺旋或扭转。

sentences.en: And so, while you're spinning, you also do this sort of upside-down part, and then you go off into the launch.
sentences.zh: 所以当你旋转时，你还会经历这种倒立的部分，然后进入弹射区。

sentences.en: So, there's a lot going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，里面有很多花样。

sentences.en: If you like a lot of combinations of thrills, this—this ride just packs them in.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢多种刺激的组合，这个设施简直应有尽有。

sentences.en: So— You know, when we talk about the limits of human ingenuity, and we talk about going to space, and we talk about all the things that we haven't done yet,
sentences.zh: 所以——你知道，当我们谈论人类智慧的极限，谈论太空探索，谈论我们尚未完成的所有事情时，

sentences.en: it's just—I feel like it's all in roller coaster design here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这一切都体现在过山车设计上了。

sentences.en: Like, that's where all the great creativity is going.
sentences.zh: 所有的创造力都汇聚在那里。

sentences.en: I love how deep you go, Mikado.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你钻研得这么深，Mikado。

sentences.en: You know the manufacturers, you know the advancements in track technology.
sentences.zh: 你了解制造商，了解轨道技术的进步。

sentences.en: Do you look at, like, schematics before the roller coaster's out?
sentences.zh: 你会在过山车推出前看设计图吗？

sentences.en: Is that—how are you tracking the construction of these things beforehand?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么提前追踪这些设施的建设情况的？

sentences.en: Oh, definitely.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: I mean, when Epic Universe was being built, there were a lot of channels out there.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当“史诗宇宙”在建时，有很多频道在关注。

sentences.en: There was a YouTube channel called Theme Park Stop that was tracking the building of Epic Universe.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫Theme Park Stop的YouTube频道一直在追踪“史诗宇宙”的建设。

sentences.en: And they would go and look at permits to sort of say, it looks like this ride is probably going to be this, and this is where it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 他们会去查看许可证，从而推断出这个设施大概会是什么，以及它会建在哪里。

sentences.en: And I was following that stuff for a year, at least a year, before that park opened.
sentences.zh: 在那个乐园开业前，我至少追踪了一年这些内容。

sentences.en: Um, but yes, I do track the manufacturers and watch a lot of the on-ride videos, which are cool, but they don't really capture, like,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但确实，我会追踪制造商，也会看很多乘车视频，这些视频很酷，但它们无法真正捕捉到，

sentences.en: the full experience of what your body goes through on a ride.
sentences.zh: 你的身体在设施上经历的完整体验。

sentences.en: I mean, you can go and watch the Ride to Happiness on-ride video, but it is not going to be anything like your body twisting and spinning and going upside down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你可以去看“幸福之旅”的乘车视频，但那绝对比不上你身体实际感受到的扭转、旋转和倒立。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think there are lots of people, Mikado, who, you know, for physical reasons, whatever, can't get on roller coasters.
sentences.zh: Mikado，我想有很多人因为身体原因或其他原因无法乘坐过山车。

sentences.en: There are people who are also afraid to get on roller coasters and who look at someone like you, maybe me, maybe Brooks is this person, and says, why would you do this?
sentences.zh: 也有人害怕坐过山车，他们看着像你这样的人，也许是我，也许Brooks也是这样的人，会问，你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: It is—why would you wait online for 45 minutes to feel scared or to feel these feelings?
sentences.zh: 为什么要排45分钟的队去感受恐惧或这些感觉？

sentences.en: What is the appeal of roller coasters for you?
sentences.zh: 过山车对你来说有什么吸引力？

sentences.en: Well, one of the things I really like about it is that it's a controlled thrill.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真正喜欢它的一点是，这是一种可控的刺激。

sentences.en: Like, I do like thrills, but I don't like all thrills.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢刺激，但我不是所有刺激都喜欢。

sentences.en: I'm not into, say, bungee jumping or skydiving, which feels a little bit scarier to me, because if I'm bungee jumping, it's just me.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢蹦极或跳伞，那对我来说感觉更可怕，因为如果我去蹦极，只有我一个人。

sentences.en: And so if something goes wrong, I'm the only person paying for it.
sentences.zh: 如果出了什么差错，只有我一个人承担后果。

sentences.en: But the parks do their absolute best to make sure that these rides are safe and secure, and I feel pretty confident of that most of the time that I'm riding a roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 但乐园会尽最大努力确保这些设施安全可靠，大多数时候我坐过山车时都感到相当自信。

sentences.en: But it's still taking me to do something that I otherwise just wouldn't be able to do,
sentences.zh: 但它依然带我去做了一些我平时根本做不到的事情，

sentences.en: taking me up a giant hill and then dropping me down and upside down and into loops and everything.
sentences.zh: 带我上巨大的坡道，然后把我扔下去，倒立，进入环形轨道等等。

sentences.en: So that's the big appeal to me, this controlled way to have a little bit of chaos in my life.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是它对我最大的吸引力，一种在生活中获得一点混乱的可控方式。

sentences.en: I could ask you a question, or you could just respond to it.
sentences.zh: 我可以问你一个问题，或者你可以直接回应它。

sentences.en: Well, so Brooks, why don't you like that?
sentences.zh: 好吧，Brooks，你为什么不喜欢那样？

sentences.en: I used to like roller coasters.
sentences.zh: 我以前喜欢过山车。

sentences.en: But I guess my fear or hesitation goes back to the carnival, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 但我想我的恐惧或犹豫要追溯到嘉年华，说实话。

sentences.en: I could ride any ride I wanted, my parents said, but I could never ride the Zyklon, which was a roller coaster on the carnival, because my parents considered that unsafe.
sentences.zh: 我父母说我可以坐任何我想坐的设施，但我绝对不能坐Zyklon，那是嘉年华上的一个过山车，因为我父母认为它不安全。

sentences.en: And so there's probably, you know, some...
sentences.zh: 所以可能有一些……

sentences.en: Did you see things?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么吗？

sentences.en: Did you see things as a traveling carnival?
sentences.zh: 你以前去过那种流动嘉年华吗？

sentences.en: For sure, yes.
sentences.zh: 当然，去过。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes you...
sentences.zh: 是啊，那会让你……

sentences.en: You know, this was the 80s, and a traveling carnival, and inspections weren't what they are today.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，那是80年代，那种流动嘉年华，安检可不像今天这么严格。

sentences.en: I guess, you know, there's lingering trepidation around some of this.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，人们对这些东西还是心有余悸。

sentences.en: I also just think, you know, I do not think this is fun.
sentences.zh: 而且我只是觉得，你知道，我不觉得这有什么好玩的。

sentences.en: I'm glad, I'm excited to be doing something I could never do otherwise.
